page.overview:
Who is Beebox?

Beebox was a male bounty hunter of an unknown humanoid alien species active during the Galactic Civil War. After joining Chelli Lona Aphra, Bossk, Krrsantan, and IG-90 on the Son-tuul Pride robbery, Beebox eventually received a bounty to kill or capture Aphra. When he brought in a disintegrated body that was not Aphra to attempt to claim the bounty, he was killed by Darth Vader, who sensed his deception.

Beebox met up at a bar on Son-tuul with fellow bounty hunters Bossk and IG-90, who wanted to know where Krrsantan was. He explained that Krrsantan was fighting in the pit, confusing to others, especially Bossk, who wondered why an ex-Xonti Brothers gladiator would want to relive those moments. Beebox suggested that he got nostalgic. After Krrsantan stopped fighting, Bossk, Beebox, Krrsantan, and IG-90 had a drink in the bar. Dr. Aphra, who had recently worked with Darth Vader, explained to the bounty hunter team that Darth Vader recently killed the Son-tuul Pride leader, and the Sith Lord had taken off the Hutt credits to an Imperial light cruiser, which IG-90 explained everyone knew. Aphra told the team that she knew exactly where it was going, and she could make them rich.

The bounty hunter group headed to the Anthan system, outside the space of Anthan Prime, on Aphra's personal ship, the Ark Angel, planning to rob the ship. Aphra blew up an "asteroid," and the ship they were keeping the bounty was surrounded by debris. Aphra sent out an ion torpedo and explained that they would think that their power was cut due to the asteroid field. When Beebox and the rest of the crew broke into the ship, they deactivated the shields so Krrsantan, in his ship, could blow the ship's bridge and Aphra's astromech Beetee could magnetically pulled as many credits out as he could, although Krrsantan actually used his ship's secret magnetic feature to pull a few credits in for himself.

After the heist on Anthan Prime, Beebox and the others received their payment, but since a lot of the money "floated away," the amount was fewer than expected. The group then made plans to attack Aphra, but Aphra explained that she would not take a share in an attempt to dissuade them.
